title: UE World Partition Validate

recipes.title: Audit the current partitioned world

steps.purpose: Read the current level and determine whether World Partition is active before deeper checks.

List Data Layer effective states and audit HLOD readiness.

Inspect PCG components only after live availability confirms the optional PCG module.
